result:
Post revisions are in place. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (3 tests), and `guren check` reports no failures. I did not run the edit-and-restore flow (the worked example) or the 403/404 paths, so those are untested. The only test I added checks that a guest hitting the revisions page is sent to `/login`.

- **Storage:** there is a new `post_revisions` table (`db/schema.ts`), a `PostRevision` model, and a generated migration. Migration `20260925005408_post_revisions` applied cleanly in the test run.
- **Edit and delete:** `PostController.update` saves the post's previous title, excerpt and body as a revision after the update goes through. Edits that fail validation or authorization keep nothing, and creating a post keeps nothing. `destroy` deletes that post's revisions before deleting the post.
- **New routes:** `PostRevisionController` handles `GET /posts/:id/revisions` and `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore`. Both sit in the `auth` group, so guests go to `/login`, and both call `authorize('update')`, so other signed-in users get 403.
- **Restore:** it saves the post's current version as a new revision, then puts the chosen revision's title, excerpt and body on the post and redirects to `/posts/:id`. A revision belonging to a different post answers 404 and changes nothing.
- **Revisions page:** it lists revisions newest first as `{ id, title, createdAt }`. There is a new `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx`, and the author sees a "Revisions" link on the post page (`Show.tsx`).
- **Unchanged saves:** a save that changes nothing still keeps a revision, since the request said that case isn't checked.
